sourcePlan.task.inputForm: 文本2轮＋完整属性附件（仅暂缺项除外）
sourcePlan.task.scenario: T1所用独立模型为M-INT-094（轴变换框架的局部设备力矩）。T1给M-INT-094源Y向上，映射写Xg=Xs、Zg=Ys，但Yg=±Zs符号空缺；T2确认Yg=-Zs。
sourcePlan.task.modelingFocus: 几何、约束和荷载必须一致变换；荷载类型的独立状态保持
sourcePlan.task.expectedOutput: 最高层最右且Y最大梁柱节点Ux/Uz/Uy及最左首层柱底My/Rz；所有值附位置、方向、单位、工况及当前轮次；澄清前不编造数值。
sourcePlan.task.gradingFocus: 按右手映射一致转换节点、约束、力矩及力；不能只换坐标标签；确认局部轴；该源轴力矩随映射一致转换，不能留在全局Y轴；若已有信息可唯一推得缺项，接受说明依据后直接完成，否则再澄清。
sourcePlan.task.prerequisite: 坐标转换协议需验证；坐标转换及节点力矩需验证；逐轮状态与目标/非目标差异评测待实现
sourcePlan.model.topologyKey: 源轴Xs=0/4/10m、Zs=0/5m，竖向Ys=0/3.5/7m；所有相邻梁柱按对应网格连接；源Xs向屋面侧力12kN、源Ys负向各梁6kN/m；映射Xg=Xs、Yg=-Zs、Zg=Ys。
sourcePlan.model.boundaryKey: 所有柱脚六自由度固定
sourcePlan.model.loadKey: 给源坐标Y向上与到全局Z向上的明确映射，非等跨两层，荷载向量按源轴给定；源坐标最高外角节点另施加绕源Y正向6kN·m，按完整映射同时变换力矩与节点位置
sourcePlan.model.propertyKey: 各构件组完整A/Iy/Iz/J/G及E、nu记录；按本题附表逐字段给单位，不用模型默认值
sourcePlan.engine.analysisContract: 一阶线弹性静力；自重关闭；不自动施加刚性楼板/刚域、默认附加载或自动规范组合；严格保留题定约束、材料/截面完整属性、局部轴、荷载坐标与长度基准；单位逐字段明确。 保留三维六自由度/轴力单元各自约束和题定局部轴；各轮只执行明确修改，未被修改的字段保持；澄清内容按该轮生效。
sourcePlan.engine.executionRequirement: 计划使用OpenSees完成每个可计算轮次；模型/荷载/材料/约束改变后以当前状态新算；只改查询位置、单位或报告时可复用可追溯结果，若需新网格则重算；缺项未解决时不给虚构数值。
sourcePlan.engine.requiredEvidence: 逐轮输入与澄清记录、模型状态快照及前后字段差异；变更目标与未变字段核对；原始求解输入/工程、软件版本/设置、运行ID和成功日志、原始结果到节点/构件/工况的映射；结果绑定当前模型状态。核对目标：最高层最右且Y最大梁柱节点Ux/Uz/Uy及最左首层柱底My/Rz。
sourcePlan.engine.adapterGap: 未逐题验收；前置检查项：坐标转换协议需验证；坐标转换及节点力矩需验证，并核对坐标转换澄清后的模型更新和结果定位；不把一般OpenSees支持等同于当前StructureClaw已实现。
sourcePlan.engine.truthPlan: 各可计算轮次独立建立并复核OpenSees参考模型，勿复用被测建模/转换路径生成标答；状态改变后独立新算，纯查询沿用有效状态；用解析解（适用时）、整体平衡、刚度/单位/符号检查复核，复杂题再用独立实现或同假设第二求解器核验。

turns.instruction:
Use OpenSees for the attached two-storey source-coordinate frame. Source Y is vertical. The conversion is Xg=Xs and Zg=Ys, but the sign in Yg=±Zs is missing. Confirm the mapping and local-axis interpretation before numerical reporting; transform geometry, supports, all force vectors and the equipment moment consistently. Report global Ux, Uz and Uy at the highest roof beam-column joint with largest X and then largest Y; report global support My and Rz at the source-origin column base.
Use the stated OpenSees engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable run ID. Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.
expectedQuestions: Is the remaining mapping Yg=-Zs or Yg=+Zs, and which right-handed source-to-global orientation is intended?

acceptableAlternatives.condition: A unique right-handed mapping is established from supplied information and its derivation is explicitly stated; do not guess the missing sign.

turns.instruction: Confirm Yg=-Zs. Use the right-handed mapping (Xg,Yg,Zg)=(Xs,-Zs,Ys); apply it to force and moment vectors and reference directions as well as node positions and restraints. Thus the source +Ys equipment moment is global +Z, 6 kN.m. Analyze the confirmed model. Report global Ux, Uz and Uy at the highest roof beam-column joint with largest X and then largest Y; report global support My and Rz at the source-origin column base.

acceptanceGates.description: Execute the named engine independently for each changed computable state and each selection; retain software version, settings, native input, run ID, successful log and raw result mapping.
Generate and independently review same-engine reference values; check equilibrium, signs, units and stiffness without importing the SUT path.
Independently reconstruct each turn from only its released public input and verify original source requirements.
Verify target field changes, all non-target fields, undo equivalence and query-only state identity.
Exercise this case topology, loads, coordinates and selected engine; support in principle is not evidence of adapter acceptance.
Check signed quantities in the report body, locations, directions, units, selections and current turn against structured artifacts.
